description: Schema for extracting structured information from an invoice document.

invoiceNumber.description: The unique identifier for the invoice.

invoiceDate.description: The date when the invoice was issued, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

dueDate.description: The date when the invoice payment is due, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

vendor.description: Information about the vendor or seller.

name.description: The name of the vendor or seller.

address.description: The full address of the vendor or seller.

email.description: The email address of the vendor or seller.

customer.description: Information about the customer or bill-to party.

name.description: The name of the customer or bill-to party.

address.description: The full address of the customer or bill-to party.

lineItems.description: A list of individual items or services billed on the invoice.

description.description: A description of the item or service.

quantity.description: The quantity of the item or service.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the item or service.

lineTotal.description: The total amount for this line item (quantity * unit price).

subtotal.description: The sum of all line item totals before taxes and discounts.

taxAmount.description: The total amount of tax applied to the invoice.

taxRate.description: The percentage rate of tax applied (e.g., 0.08875 for 8.875%).

totalAmount.description: The grand total amount of the invoice, including subtotal and tax.
